name: MACS J0510.7-0801 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J0510.7-0801, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj051070801-hubble
story: A rich cluster of galaxies, gathered up in a Hubble snapshot survey of extreme, X-ray-bright clusters. The survey looks for clusters massive enough to act as gravitational lenses, bending the light of galaxies far behind them.

claims.text: MACS J0510.7-0801 is a rich galaxy cluster targeted by a snapshot survey of extreme, highly X-ray-luminous clusters
The survey aims to find powerful gravitational lenses
